crossRefs.note: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel Aviv, that lived by the river Chebar, and to where they lived; and I sat…
The Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the captives. So the vision…
Then I spoke to the captives all the things that Yahweh had shown me.
Then they answered and said before the king, “That Daniel, who is of the children of the captivity of Judah, doesn’t…
“Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and tell them, ‘When I bring the sword on a land, and the people of…
“You, son of man, tell the children of your people, ‘The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him in the day…
“ ‘Yet the children of your people say, “The way of the Lord is not fair;” but as for them, their way is not fair.
“As for you, son of man, the children of your people talk about you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and…
“When the children of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Won’t you show us what you mean by these?’
Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go, get down; for your people, who you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted…
Yahweh said to me, “Arise, get down quickly from here; for your people whom you have brought out of Egypt have…
“At that time Michael will stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there will be a…
But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says.’ He who…
They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse, for they are a rebellious house, yet they will know that…
You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.
Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,
for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.

translations.web: Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says,’ whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse.
translations.bsb: Go to your people, the exiles; speak to them and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ whether they listen or refuse to listen.”
translations.kjv: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.
translations.asv: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.
